name: core-reactions-holds-revised
description: Reactions' holds and revised. holds fires when a change of a linked instance makes an all or any rollup of the instance hold: on the edge from not holding to holding, judged with the other linked instances as they are when the rule runs, and up a tree of the type's own schema to the runner's depth limit. revised fires when the instance a link points to gains a revision, or a release when its schema composes Branches, on each instance whose link points there, of a link pinned to what the target gained only the ones the target has moved past. parseConfig holds both to the type's Rollups and Links, and a link to a schema with neither Revisions nor Branches halts the subscription.

scenarios.name: Reactions: holds (node) > a change that makes an all rollup hold sets the rule off, once: a later change while it holds does not
Reactions: holds (node) > an any rollup fires when it comes to hold, not again while it holds, and again once it has stopped
Reactions: holds (node) > a step linked in a state it counts in, or linked away, moves the rollup as its link does
Reactions: holds (node) > an all rollup sets the rule off over at least one instance: the delete of the last step that kept it out fires when a passed step is left, not when none is
Reactions: holds (node) > up a tree of its own schema, each parent completes as its last subtask does, to the depth limit
Reactions: holds (node) > parseConfig holds a holds rule to an all or any rollup of the type's Rollups

scenarios.name: Reactions: revised (node) > a spec's new revision moves the work pinned to an earlier one, as the runner, and nothing else moves it
Reactions: revised (node) > of a pinned link, only the work the target has moved past moves: one pinned to the new revision since is left alone
Reactions: revised (node) > of a link with no pin, every instance that points at the target moves at each revision
Reactions: revised (node) > a release of a schema that composes Branches moves the work linked to it; its other operations do not
Reactions: revised (node) > of a link pinned to a release, a release moves only the work pinned to an earlier one; a revision of the target moves every one
Reactions: revised (node) > a link to a schema with neither Revisions nor Branches halts the subscription with what is wrong
